name: 18218-sharegpt1024-bamba9b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one in-process vLLM engine, which runs V0 on this commit.
architecture: hybrid state-space + attention decoder (BambaForCausalLM), 32 layers, 4096-token context window, 9.78e9 parameters, F16 on the hub (~19.6 GB of weights).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1000, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown. streams equals max_requests, so all 1000 requests are offered at t=0 and none is resubmitted.
workload: ShareGPT V3 unfiltered cleaned split, 1000 single-turn prompts, every request forced to exactly 1024 output tokens with ignore_eos. The rows are configs/data/sharegpt-1000-out1024-bamba9b.jsonl; greedy decoding (temperature 0) and request_format plain -- no chat template, a completions-shaped request against a base checkpoint.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on one GPU, serving a 9-billion-parameter model to 1000 users at once.
launch:
model: ibm-ai-platform/Bamba-9B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

# The scheduler values this engine would pick at this context length, written out so a default
# cannot drift them. HAZARD: with chunked prefill off the engine refuses a token budget below
# max-model-len -- raise the two together or not at all.
enable-chunked-prefill: false
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
